lines.text: Jacob hears Laban's sons say he built his wealth at their father's expense, and the LORD tells him to go back.
Jacob calls Rachel and Leah to the field and says Laban changed his wages seven times.
In a dream, the angel of God tells Jacob he is the God of Bethel and tells him to leave.
Jacob puts his children and wives on camels to go to Isaac, and Leah steals her father's household idols.
Jacob deceives Laban by not telling him he is running away, then crosses the Euphrates and heads for Gilead.
